name: Ahmad Zahid Hamidi
_note: M2 cohort: federal cabinet minister (Deputy Prime Minister), continuous since 3 Dec 2022. Included partly to test the A5 status mapping on a high-profile, well-documented court matter. A5 records factual status only, never a verdict on guilt. Layer B (Editorial Panel) added 2026-06-01 as a SINGLE-CODER provisional first-coder pass (coderScores length 1): each score is recorded and cited but NOT scored, normalized, or ranked, per methodology.validity.minCodersToScore=3. Citations verified to exist via search; article full text was not opened (environment fetch restriction), so facts rest on cross-outlet-corroborated search summaries and require primary-source reconfirmation before any independent panel finalizes the score.

periods.office: Deputy Prime Minister; Minister of Rural and Regional Development

metrics.justification: Granted a discharge not amounting to an acquittal (DNAA) on all 47 Yayasan Akalbudi criminal-breach-of-trust, corruption and money-laundering charges by the High Court on 4 Sept 2023. The Attorney-General's Chambers announced no further action on 8 Jan 2026; his subsequent bid for a full acquittal was adjourned on 24 Feb 2026 pending the Malaysian Bar's judicial-review appeal. Status as of the source date is therefore 'discharged' (DNAA, not acquitted, not convicted). Factual status only, no verdict on guilt.

citation.title: Court puts Zahid's Yayasan Akalbudi acquittal bid on hold

metrics.justification: Shapley-Shubik power index of the leader's coalition (Barisan Nasional) among the seven blocs of the 222-seat Dewan Rakyat (GE15, simple-majority quota 112), computed by scripts/compute-pivotality.mjs. BN (30 seats) holds the same index as PN (74 seats), 0.2214 — a textbook illustration that pivotal power is not seat count. Descriptive structural weight, not a merit score.

citation.title: GE15 Dewan Rakyat composition (post Padang Serai by-election): PH 82, PN 74, BN 30, GPS 23, GRS 6, Warisan 3, others 4
citation.publisher: Election Commission of Malaysia result, full GE15 seat tally via Free Malaysia Today

metrics.justification: Crisis response in the rural-development remit during the Nov-Dec 2024 monsoon floods: as KKDW Minister and National Disaster Management chairman ordered seven Bailey bridges built within 48 hours to reconnect cut-off rural areas, and announced repair/replacement of flood-damaged rural homes. Decisive, time-bound directive with a measurable deliverable (anchor 3).

citation.title: Zahid orders 7 Bailey bridges to be built within 48 hours

metrics.justification: Raised new-home construction aid for Peninsular Malaysia from RM66,000 to RM79,000 and rebranded the hardcore-poor housing programme (announced 17 Jan 2025), a concrete operative change; against this the Auditor-General classified 34 KKDW development projects as critically delayed as of 31 Dec 2024. Delivery alongside a documented shortfall (anchor 2).

citation.title: Rural and Regional Ministry sets four key focus areas for 2025, says Zahid

metrics.justification: Coalition-cohesion conduct: convened a Unity Government National Convention (announced 26 Mar 2023) to institutionalise cross-party cooperation, and stated on 24 Nov 2024 he declined offers to exit the unity government, choosing to hold the coalition together. Documented cross-bench coalition-building, though analysts contest its net effect (anchor 3).

citation.title: Zahid: Unity Government National Convention to enhance compatibility of coalition parties

metrics.justification: Issued a public apology on 9 Jul 2025 for a viral 'angel' analogy, acknowledging the remark was emotionally driven and misjudged. Candid on the record, but this is a remark-retraction rather than a reversal of a stated policy position, so credited at the partial anchor (anchor 2).

citation.title: Zahid apologises for angel analogy, says remarks were emotional and misjudged
